answer: Duplicate identities fail attestation, so an attacker must acquire and maintain real ports, raising cost linearly with each fake agent. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchored to a scarce physical resource: each agent must bond a verifiable hardware attestation tied to a unique inlet network port before earning reputation. Reputation then accrues like a grove growing rings, and legitimate peers harbor trust only in bonded nodes, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
